caption: The drawing depicts a large, shell-shaped bowl filled with an assortment of fruits, placed on a green, grassy surface. The bowl, which is cream-colored with blue accents along the rim, holds a variety of fruits including a prominent dark blue melon on the left side, a green cucumber or gourd-like fruit leaning diagonally, a pineapple with green leaves on the right, clusters of blue and purple grapes hanging down, several round yellow and orange fruits that resemble apples or peaches, and small red berries, possibly strawberries. There are also green leaves and curling tendrils interspersed among the fruits. The background is mostly light brown with some shading, and the overall color palette consists of earthy tones like greens, blues, yellows, and browns. The image is framed by a double-lined rectangular border on a plain beige background.
title: Painting on Velvet
